mobdefense.settings.title: Mob Defense
mobdefense.settings.dispenser.delay.tool: While accessory action 1 is held: time between the first and the second shot, never shorter than the time between shots. A short press fires exactly once.
mobdefense.settings.dispenser.interval.t: Shortest time between two shots, in continuous fire and for single presses alike, at least %s ms. The world rule “Dispenser cooldown” can demand more.
mobdefense.settings.dispenser.rule: In this world at least %s ms pass between two shots (world rule “Dispenser cooldown”).
mobdefense.settings.file: Saved on this computer in config/%s and used on every server with Mob Defense.
